say:0:1011602001:0.text: I missed walking down this road...

say:1:1011602002:0.text: Back when I was just a regular guard, I trained around this area while gazing at the Lucent Tree.
say:1:1011602002:0.source_cn: 我还是一名普通卫士的时候，经常在这附近仰望着流荧树训练。

say:0:1011604001:0.text: Oh no, the Thorned Guards are here!

say:2:1011608002:1.source_cn: 咕唔，帕瑞莎长官，真的是您！

choice_prompt:3:1011608002.source_cn: 咕唔，帕瑞莎长官，真的是您！

say:4:1011608003:1.source_cn: 这是卡夫拉，我曾经的副手。

say:5:1011608004:1.text: I, remain the deputy unto Captain Parisa!
say:5:1011608004:1.source_cn: 吾，此时也是帕瑞莎长官的副手！
say:5:1011608004:1.male: I, remain the deputy unto Captain Parisa!
say:5:1011608004:1.female: I, remain the deputy unto Captain Parisa!

say:6:1011608005:1.text: I'm no longer captain of the Thorned Guards, so you should stop calling me that.
say:6:1011608005:1.source_cn: ……我已经不是荆棘卫队的队长了，不该再这么称呼我。

say:9:1011608007:1.text: Hoot! Outlander! Utterance cometh only with Captain Parisa's grant!
say:9:1011608007:1.source_cn: 咕唔！外乡人！帕瑞莎长官许可后才可发言！
say:9:1011608007:1.male: Hoot! Outlander! Utterance cometh only with Captain Parisa's grant!
say:9:1011608007:1.female: Hoot! Outlander! Utterance cometh only with Captain Parisa's grant!

say:10:1011608008:1.text: Kafra, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a mage brought in by the Windwhisperer, and I've seen him use magic firsthand to clear out corruption.
say:10:1011608008:1.source_cn: 卡夫拉，这是风语从外界请回的魔法师<style=str...
say:10:1011608008:1.male: Kafra, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a mage brought in by the Windwhisperer, and I've seen him use magic firsthand to clear out corruption.
say:10:1011608008:1.female: Kafra, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a mage brought in by the Windwhisperer, and I've seen her use magic firsthand to clear out corruption.

say:12:1011608010:1.text: An outlander graced with such might! It behooves us to accord him the utmost courtesy!
say:12:1011608010:1.source_cn: 竟——竟有如此之能的外乡人！吾等当用最高礼节迎接才是！
say:12:1011608010:1.male: An outlander graced with such might! It behooves us to accord him the utmost courtesy!
say:12:1011608010:1.female: An outlander graced with such might! It behooves us to accord her the utmost courtesy!

choice_prompt:13:1011608010.text: An outlander graced with such might! It behooves us to accord him the utmost courtesy!
choice_prompt:13:1011608010.source_cn: 竟——竟有如此之能的外乡人！吾等当用最高礼节迎接才是！
choice_prompt:13:1011608010.male: An outlander graced with such might! It behooves us to accord him the utmost courtesy!
choice_prompt:13:1011608010.female: An outlander graced with such might! It behooves us to accord her the utmost courtesy!

say:15:1011608012:0.text: I take it you're not working for Eomir?
say:15:1011608012:0.source_cn: 所以，听你们的意思……你们和伊米尔不是一伙的？

say:16:1011608013:0.text: We art the subordinates of Captain Parisa. After the captain's departure, we hath been reassigned and stationed hither.
say:16:1011608013:0.source_cn: 吾等是帕瑞莎部下。长官离任后，吾等被接连调职，下放于此。

say:18:1011608014:1.text: Were you all affected by my dismissal?!
say:18:1011608014:1.source_cn: 我被革职，连你们也受牵连了吗？！

say:19:1011608015:1.text:
We pledge fealty to the Thorned Faction.
A sage bereft of wisdom merits no allegiance, verily!
say:19:1011608015:1.source_cn: 吾等效忠荆棘。\n贤者不贤，当然无忠可献！

say:20:1011608016:1.text: You saw more clearly than I did...

say:21:1011608017:1.text: Captain, we are assembled nigh. Thou mayst proceed to inspect and take respite!
say:21:1011608017:1.source_cn: 长官，吾等已在附近重新集结，您可前往视察休憩！

say:24:1011608018:1.text: Brillia, Rosetta, secure the found provisions and make haste to return to camp!
say:24:1011608018:1.source_cn: 布拉苜，萝赛塔，收好寻到的物资，列队回营！

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 帕瑞莎的副手，为什么在这里？

say:1:1011609002:0.text: Hoot! Sir Hamster, wherefore art thou troubled? There be no populace here.
say:1:1011609002:0.source_cn: 咕唔，仓鼠阁下，为何介怀？此处并无人烟。

say:1:1011610001:2.text: Captain Parisa?! I'm surprised to see you here!
say:1:1011610001:2.source_cn: ——帕瑞莎队长！您竟然也来这里了？！

say:2:1011610002:2.text: Although there's no place for us in the camp, we've been following your teachings and haven't slacked on our training for a single minute!
say:2:1011610002:2.source_cn: 虽然卫队里现在没有我们的容身之地，但是我们一直谨遵您的...

say:7:1011610004:0.text: Captain, our hearts doth not covet the title of captain, but in thee, we place our unwavering trust!
say:7:1011610004:0.source_cn: 长官，吾等并非仰慕荆棘队长一职，而是信任着您！

choice_prompt:8:1011610004.text: Captain, our hearts doth not covet the title of captain, but in thee, we place our unwavering trust!
choice_prompt:8:1011610004.source_cn: 长官，吾等并非仰慕荆棘队长一职，而是信任着您！

say:9:1011610005:0.text: You're right. I should never have wasted my time on regrets...
say:9:1011610005:0.source_cn: ……是。我本不该将时间错付在睡梦和悔恨中……
say:9:1011610005:0.male: You're right. I should never have wasted my time on regrets...
say:9:1011610005:0.female: You're right. I should never have wasted my time on regrets...

say:11:1011610006:1.text: That's enough self-reflection. Parisa, what is needed now is action!
say:11:1011610006:1.source_cn: 帕瑞莎，反思已经做得够多了，接下来需要的，是行动！

say:14:1011610008:1.text: Kafra, did you notice anything strange from Eomir before he reassigned you?
say:14:1011610008:1.source_cn: 卡夫拉，伊米尔将你们贬职调任前，还有什么异常的举动？

say:15:1011610009:1.text: For instance, did he ever make contact with strangers? Was there any sighting of a woman in black near the camp?
say:15:1011610009:1.source_cn: 比如是否曾与陌生人联络？是否有黑衣女性出没于主营附近？

say:16:1011610010:1.text: We need all the intel we can get.
say:16:1011610010:1.source_cn: 我们需要一切可用的情报。

say:17:1011610011:1.text: I doth recall, Rosetta hath submitted a report regarding the anomalous transfer of supplies.
say:17:1011610011:1.source_cn: ……吾记得，萝赛塔曾呈递过物资异常调用的报告。

say:19:1011610012:0.text: Yes, Captain! After you left, a new group of guards came to the main camp. I readied their equipment and counted the supplies.
say:19:1011610012:0.source_cn: 是！帕瑞莎队长。您离开后，一批新卫士调来主营，我一边替...

say:20:1011610013:0.text: Then I noticed something unusual—the number of weapons didn't match the inventory list.
say:20:1011610013:0.source_cn: 就在那时，我发现了异常——武器数量与实查的对不上。

say:21:1011610014:0.text: They really covered their tracks with the transfer records. I wouldn't have caught it if I hadn't noticed something odd about the delivery locations!
say:21:1011610014:0.source_cn: 调拨记录伪造得很小心，如果不是留意到运送地的奇怪之处，...

choice_prompt:22:1011610014.text: They really covered their tracks with the transfer records. I wouldn't have caught it if I hadn't noticed something odd about the delivery locations!
choice_prompt:22:1011610014.source_cn: 调拨记录伪造得很小心，如果不是留意到运送地的奇怪之处，我也很难发现！

say:24:1011610016:1.text: According to the records, under Master Eomir's name, multiple shipments of longbows and axes were <style="highlight">dispatched beyond the forest</style> to aid Wilders in different regions.
say:24:1011610016:1.source_cn: 记录上写着，奉伊米尔贤者之名，调拨了几批长弓和刀斧，<...
say:24:1011610016:1.male: According to the records, under Master Eomir's name, multiple shipments of longbows and axes were <style="highlight">dispatched beyond the forest</style> to aid Wilders in different regions.
say:24:1011610016:1.female: According to the records, under Master Eomir's name, multiple shipments of longbows and axes were <style="highlight">dispatched beyond the forest</style> to aid Wilders in different regions.

say:25:1011610017:1.text: But the intel officer said there haven't been any requests for assistance in recent years!
say:25:1011610017:1.source_cn: 但，我又询问了情报官，得知近年来都没有其他地区的求援记录！
say:25:1011610017:1.male: But the intel officer said there haven't been any requests for assistance in recent years!

say:29:1011610019:0.source_cn: 确实只有丛林里的绿裔成员，才能将薄暮巡游队的巡查时间了...

say:32:1011610021:1.text: Eomir... going so far as to spread corruption in the forest to snatch power from the other two factions, and directing bandits to assault his own people!
say:32:1011610021:1.source_cn: 伊米尔……为了从风语和薄暮中夺取权力，以避人耳目的形式...
say:32:1011610021:1.male: Eomir... going so far as to spread corruption in the forest to snatch power from the other two factions, and directing bandits to assault his own people!

say:33:1011610022:1.text: As a member of the Thorned Faction, does he not feel guilty?!
say:33:1011610022:1.source_cn: 他的荆棘之心，究竟去了哪里？！
say:33:1011610022:1.male: As a member of the Thorned Faction, does he not feel guilty?!
say:33:1011610022:1.female: As a member of the Thorned Faction, does he not feel guilty?!

say:34:1011610023:1.text: Kafra, get everyone into their formation.

say:37:1011610025:1.text: I will retake command of the Thorned Guards, admit our mistakes, and bear the consequences.
say:37:1011610025:1.source_cn: 我要重新统领荆棘卫队，坦白我们的错误，承担应当承担的责任。

say:38:1011610026:1.text: It'll take some time, but acting now is better than regretting later.
say:38:1011610026:1.source_cn: 这会花上一些时间。但现在行动总比之后的悔恨好。

say:40:1011610027:0.text: Everyone, I haven't taken action for too long, and I shall no longer let down the guards who have supported me.
say:40:1011610027:0.source_cn: 各位……我已经消沉了太久，不能再辜负支持我的卫士们。

choice_prompt:41:1011610027.text: Everyone, I haven't taken action for too long, and I shall no longer let down the guards who have supported me.
choice_prompt:41:1011610027.source_cn: 各位……我已经消沉了太久，不能再辜负支持我的卫士们。

say:42:1011610028:0.text: With you around, I trust we can cleanse the corruption. Now, the guards and I are going to make amends for the Thorned Faction's previous wrongs.
say:42:1011610028:0.source_cn: 是。有你在，我相信腐化一定能够消除。而我和卫士们能做的...
say:42:1011610028:0.male: With you around, I trust we can cleanse the corruption. Now, the guards and I are going to make amends for the Thorned Faction's previous wrongs.

say:44:1011610030:1.male: I've inscribed my <style="highlight">teleportation spell</style> in this book.
say:44:1011610030:1.female: I've inscribed my <style="highlight">teleportation spell</style> in this book.

say:45:1011610031:1.text: Although it can only be <style="highlight">used one time</style>, it can help you escape in a dire situation.
say:45:1011610031:1.male: Although it can only be <style="highlight">used one time</style>, it can help you escape in a dire situation.
say:45:1011610031:1.female: Although it can only be <style="highlight">used one time</style>, it can help you escape in a dire situation.

say:46:1011610032:0.text: It's time we bid farewell, my friends. Please save the Dark Forest, we're counting on you.
say:46:1011610032:0.source_cn: ……就此道别。朋友们，请你们拯救薄暮丛林。

choice:41:0:1.text: This is where we say goodbye.
choice:41:0:1.source_cn: 看来，我们要在这里道别了
choice:41:0:1.male: This is where we say goodbye.
choice:41:0:1.female: This is where we say goodbye.

choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 看来，那些盗匪也有伊米尔的授意

choice:26:0:1.text: Beyond the forest? Could it be...
choice:26:0:1.male: Beyond the forest? Could it be...
choice:26:0:1.female: Beyond the forest? Could it be...

choice:26:1:2.text: Those bandits know the forest well...
choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 耀光盗匪对薄暮动向很清楚……
choice:26:1:2.male: Those bandits know the forest well...
choice:26:1:2.female: Those bandits know the forest well...

say:0:1011611001:0.text: Parisa finally got her act together.
say:0:1011611001:0.source_cn: 帕瑞莎终于打起精神了。

say:1:1011611002:0.text: Hopefully, the future of the Thorned Guards will be different...
say:1:1011611002:0.source_cn: 荆棘的未来，应该会有所不同吧……

say:2:1011611003:0.text: Next stop, the Flower Grove! Let's cleanse the corruption there!
say:2:1011611003:0.source_cn: 接下来就是要去奇花漫谷，净化那里的腐化了！

say:0:1011612001:0.text: Just a little further ahead, and we'll reach the Flower Grove.
say:0:1011612001:0.source_cn: 再往前行进一阵子，就能到奇花漫谷了。

say:1:1011612002:0.text: My feet are starting to hurt...
say:1:1011612002:0.source_cn: 这一路，好远呐。我的脚都开始痛了……

say:2:1011612003:0.text: Miss Hammie, would you like to rest on my deer?
say:2:1011612003:0.source_cn: 漫漫小姐，需要坐在我的鹿上休息吗？

say:0:1011613001:0.text: Hold on! Look there, below the cliff!

say:1:1011615002:0.text: This widespread corruption even affects the mist in the valley...
say:1:1011615002:0.source_cn: 这雾气……大范围的腐化，连山谷中的雾气都影响了。

say:2:1011615003:0.text: *Cough* Everyone, try to hold your breath.

say:0:1011616001:0.text: The creatures here have also been affected by the corruption.
say:0:1011616001:0.source_cn: 果然，这里的生物也被腐化影响了。

say:0:1011617001:0.text:
I have to cleanse this place soon...
Everyone won't be able to endure this for much longer...
say:0:1011617001:0.source_cn: ……得尽快净化这里，\n否则大家都会受不了雾气……
